reason: Entries: .last_cell is reached only by the two BCS last_cell in draw_column (render.6502 1766, 1805), both go through DEC A / STA before .part_byte; .part_byte is entered only by fall-through and its own BNE (the other part_byte/last_cell at 2143-2150 are in a different scope). The compared value is identical (A after DEC A, including &FF), and CPY #imm sets N, Z, C exactly as CPY zp does, so BNE and .next_c's C=1 are unchanged; A, X, Y, stack unchanged on exit. stop_y (&C6) is named nowhere else in the renderer, sky, kind cache or tools; restore_game_zp does not keep &C6 because the logic's first access after a render is never a read (zplive), so the renderer no longer clobbering it cannot change logic (the &C6 aliases frames/y/result_high/mover_x_max_high are written before read; title_offset/zxwrk/title irq are front end only); the play irq1_handler does not touch &C6 and never runs this code. The operand lives in bank 4 sideways RAM at &9xxx, written while that code is paged (as mask_operand_2/pix_operand_2 already are). Cost: STA zp 3 -> STA abs 4 (+1 per last_cell entry), CPY zp 3 -> CPY # 2 (-1 per part_byte iteration): saves iterations-1 per entry; +1 byte overall.
